brand.name: RoadwiseFleet
index.title: RoadwiseFleet — Pilot
index.lead: A pilot-only web surface served by the pilot API on the same origin. Not the production site.
index.dashboardCard: Sign in with an owner or dispatcher account: org trip list, create trips, advance statuses.
index.driverCard: Sign in with a driver account: your assigned trips and the next legal status.
index.footer: Pilot build — data lives in the pilot database, sessions are per-tab.
dash.title: RoadwiseFleet — Pilot Dashboard
dash.lead: Live against the pilot API. Sessions are kept in this tab only.
dash.noOrders: No orders available for this org — create an order first.
dash.selectTrip: Select a trip to see its detail.
dash.trackingHint: Share a read-only link: route, status and timeline, no login and no PII.
dash.selectOrderFirst: Select an order before creating a trip.
driver.title: RoadwiseFleet — Driver
driver.description: RoadwiseFleet driver app: your current trip, one-thumb status updates and photo proof of delivery, online or offline.
driver.signInHint: Your trips only. Works offline once loaded.
driver.queueHint: Captured while offline — these send themselves when you are back online.
driver.closed: This trip is closed — no further status changes.
driver.podGate: Attach a POD photo or an eCMR below first — the server refuses POD_UPLOADED without one.
driver.captureHint: Time and GPS are attached to the photo. Without a signal it is queued on the phone and sent when you are back online.
driver.gpsUnavailable: No GPS fix — the photo will be sent without a location.
driver.gpsIdle: GPS: requested when you attach a photo.
driver.sync.rejected: Some changes were rejected by the server: {list}
driver.offlineSaved: No connection — saved on the phone and sent when you are back online.
driver.offlineFirstLoad: You are offline. Reconnect once to load your trips, then the app works offline.
driver.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
driver.error.choosePhoto: Take or choose a photo first.
driver.error.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MiB.
driver.error.unsupportedType: Unsupported file type. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF.
error.network: Network error: could not reach the server.
doctype.pod.hint: Photo of the signed delivery note
doctype.ecmr.hint: Signed consignment note — an alternative to the POD
error.notAuthorised401: Not authorised (401): please sign in again.
error.forbidden403: Forbidden (403): your role may not perform this action.
error.tripForbidden403: Forbidden (403): that trip is not assigned to you.
error.sessionExpired: Session expired (401). Please sign in again.
error.podRequired: Attach a POD or eCMR before marking the trip POD_UPLOADED.
error.unsupportedType400: Unsupported file type (400). Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF.
error.fileTooLarge400: File too large (400). The maximum is 10 MiB.
capture.badTimestamp: capturedAt must be an ISO date or epoch milliseconds
capture.geoRequired: geo.lat and geo.lng are required numbers
capture.accuracy: geo.accuracy must be a non-negative number
